response.sql: WITH race_avg AS (SELECT r.raceId, c.country, AVG(cs.points) AS ap, AVG(cs.wins) AS aw FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY r.raceId, c.country), country_avg AS (SELECT country, AVG(ap) AS avg_points, AVG(aw) AS avg_wins FROM race_avg GROUP BY country) SELECT country, avg_points, avg_wins, avg_wins - (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) FROM country_avg) AS wins_minus_mean FROM country_avg
